messages:
alice: Seeing users hit an infinite sign-out loop after SSO signout. Happens intermittently (prod eu-west). Clicking Sign Out -> redirected to IdP -> back to app but still signed in.

maria-sre: repro steps?

alice: Steps: 1) Login via SSO (Okta). 2) Click sign out on app. 3) We POST SAML LogoutRequest to https://idp.example.com/slo with RelayState. IdP responds 200 and redirects to callback, but session cookie remains. Logs show LogoutRequest SessionIndex="" for some users.

devon-sec: What do audit logs show for session index? any correlation with cookie rotation / KMS operations?

alice: From auth logs: most good requests have SessionIndex="_abc123", failing ones empty. No errors from KMS during timeframe. Link to logs: https://logs.internal/queries/abc (placeholder)

sam-platform: Could be our logout flow not writing sessionIndex into the SLO request for some paths. Are we reading session index from session cookie or DB? Also we recently rolled out path-based cookie split (SameSite/path) last week.

maria-sre: Tagging @okta-bot to see if IdP rejected anything:

okta-bot: automated note: 2 SAML SLO requests received, 0 errors; avg latency 120ms :white_check_mark:

devon-sec: Repro on staging? try debugging request made by browser — capture SLO payload.

alice: Captured payload (sanitized):

```xml
<samlp:LogoutRequest xmlns:samlp="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:protocol" ID="_L1" Version="2.0" IssueInstant="2026-03-20T14:07:00Z">
  <saml:NameID Format="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress">user@example.com</saml:NameID>
  <!-- SessionIndex missing -->
</samlp:LogoutRequest>
```

sam-platform: That makes it clear. Our logout handler should prefer sessionIndex from in-memory session store; fallback to cookie. If the migration to path-based cookies left older sessions with different cookie path maybe we read wrong cookie. Check cookie names + domain + path.

maria-sre: Can someone grep for code that sets sessionIndex into SAML payload? Check `sso/logout_handler.rb` around line 120.

alice: On it. Also adding temp mitigation: send front-end a "force-clear" client side script to wipe both cookie paths on signout. Will push a hotfix patch.

devon-sec: Good plan. After hotfix, follow-up: create audit alert when LogoutRequest.SessionIndex=="" for >1% of logins per hour.

sam-platform: I'll open a ticket to add the audit rule and add unit test for cookie-path combos.

alice: thanks all — will post postmortem after hotfix verification :thumbsup:
